note: Iowa DNR state park on 753-acre Lake Manawa at Council Bluffs. Newly built campground on the lake's southwest shore: two herringbone loops of concrete full-hookup sites with modern showers and a dump station, behind a keypad gate. --Claude
summary: Confirmed season Apr 15-Oct 15, full hookups 50 amp, 80-ft pull-throughs; FCFS some -> never; count 41 -> 40. Waterfront lead UP (not waterfront -> lakefront, sites ~31-36). Pin ~640 m off.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD UP, not waterfront -> lakefront (or lakeview if AWH reads the distance as over the line): the stored evidence was read at the stored pin, ~640 m from the campground, so it isn't evidence. On imagery the north loop's west-side back-in pads (map sites ~31-36) point out from the loop road toward the lake, with open mown grass sloping to a riprap shore, no road, path or day use between; pad ends are ~35-50 m from the water's edge (imagery estimates, Overpass down). Sites 28-30 at the loop's north tip face a shoreline tree band instead. RA tags all its sites 'Near Water - no' (generic across Iowa's RA pages read in this batch).
